predictions.articleTitle: Dewa United vs Persita Tactical Breakdown & Probabilistic Modeling: Can Persita Halt Dewa's Derby Streak?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Dewa United are projected to take at least a point (Home Win / Draw) with a 2:1 home victory favoured in an open, both-teams-to-score Liga 1 derby.
possibilityAssessment: Primary 1X2 direction Home Win / Draw led by Dewa United's home control and 2:1 convergence (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Over 2.5 goals and BTTS Yes driven by 3.31 combined lambda and fragile defensive clean-sheet rates (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
1:1 draw contingency covering post-international-break rust and Persita's 2.12 goals-per-match counter threat (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Dewa United's five-match derby streak faces Persita's 2.12 goals-per-game attack.

spf.comment: Covers Dewa United's 2:1 home win script built on 3W-1D-0L home form and five straight H2H wins alongside the 1:1 draw risk from Persita's 2.12 goals-per-match attack, since a single home call would understate Dewa's two-clean-sheet fragility.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 3.31 lambda_total (64.3% Over 2.5 Poisson baseline) and combined league scoring of 3.90 goals per match across two porous backlines.

btts.comment: Both attacks project above 79% to score (65.3% BTTS Yes baseline) against a Persita defense with zero clean sheets in eight league games and a Dewa side with two in nine.

score.comment: 2:1 reflects Dewa United's recent Liga 1 home-win margin against a scoring visitor, while 1:1 captures the top unweighted Poisson scoreline (10.0%).

goals.comment: Aligns with the top two exact-total outcomes in the Poisson baseline (22.1% for 3 goals, 20.0% for 2 goals) across the 2:1 and 1:1 scripts.

bqc.comment: Dewa United led at half-time in all five recent competitive H2Hs (Win-Win), while Win-Draw captures the main second-half equalization risk from Dewa's low clean-sheet rate.
